explanation.title: Spanish Past Tenses: Preterite, Imperfect & Perfect

sections.subtitle: Pretérito Indefinido (Preterite)
sections.content:
✅ Completed Actions with Clear Beginning/End

Regular -AR endings (hablar):
• yo → -é (hablé)
• tú → -aste (hablaste)
• él/ella → -ó (habló)
• nosotros → -amos (hablamos)
• vosotros → -asteis (hablasteis)
• ellos → -aron (hablaron)

Regular -ER/-IR endings:
• yo → -í (comí, escribí)
• tú → -iste (comiste, escribiste)
• él/ella → -ió (comió, escribió)
• nosotros → -imos (comimos, escribimos)
• vosotros → -isteis (comisteis, escribisteis)
• ellos → -ieron (comieron, escribieron)

⚠️ Common irregulars:
• ser/ir → fui, fuiste, fue
• tener → tuve, tuviste, tuvo
• hacer → hice, hiciste, hizo
• estar → estuve, estuviste, estuvo

📍 When to use:
• Specific completed actions
• Sequences of events
• Actions with clear time frames

sections.subtitle: Imperfecto (Imperfect)
sections.content:
🔄 Ongoing/Habitual/Descriptive Past

Regular -AR endings (hablaba):
• yo → -aba
• tú → -abas
• él/ella → -aba
• nosotros → -ábamos
• vosotros → -abais
• ellos → -aban

Regular -ER/-IR endings (comía, vivía):
• yo → -ía
• tú → -ías
• él/ella → -ía
• nosotros → -íamos
• vosotros → -íais
• ellos → -ían

⚠️ Only THREE irregulars:
• ser → era, eras, era
• ir → iba, ibas, iba
• ver → veía, veías, veía

📍 When to use:
• Habitual actions (used to)
• Ongoing background actions
• Descriptions in past
• Time/age in past
• Simultaneous actions

sections.subtitle: Pretérito Perfecto (Present Perfect)
sections.content:
🕐 Recent Past/Relevance to Present

Formula: HABER (present) + past participle

HABER conjugation:
• he
• has
• ha
• hemos
• habéis
• han

Past participles:
• -AR → -ado (hablado)
• -ER → -ido (comido)
• -IR → -ido (vivido)

Example:
• He comido → I have eaten
• Has hablado → You have spoken

⚠️ Irregular participles:
• hacer → hecho
• escribir → escrito
• ver → visto
• decir → dicho
• poner → puesto
• abrir → abierto
• morir → muerto
• romper → roto

🕐 Used with:
• hoy, esta semana, este año
• últimamente, ya, todavía no

sections.subtitle: Preterite vs Imperfect: Key Differences
sections.content:
⚖️ Choosing the Right Past Tense

PRETERITE (completed):
• Specific one-time actions
• Completed events
• Reactions/interruptions
• Definite time period

🔑 Trigger words:
• ayer, anoche
• el año pasado
• una vez
• de repente

IMPERFECT (ongoing):
• Habitual actions (used to/would)
• Background descriptions
• Time/weather/age
• Ongoing actions interrupted

🔑 Trigger words:
• siempre, todos los días
• mientras, generalmente
• de niño, antes

💡 Example:
Leía cuando sonó el teléfono
→ I was reading [imperfect-background]
   when the phone rang [preterite-interruption]

sections.subtitle: Past Perfect (Pluscuamperfecto)
sections.content:
⏮️ Past of the Past

Formula: HABER (imperfect) + past participle

HABER (imperfect):
• había
• habías
• había
• habíamos
• habíais
• habían

Example:
Cuando llegué, ya había comido
→ When I arrived, he had already eaten
  (eating happened BEFORE arriving)

📍 When to use:
• Actions before another past action
• Past of the past
• Setting up past context

🔑 Often used with:
• ya (already)
• todavía no (not yet)
• nunca (never)
• cuando (when)

sections.subtitle: Past Progressive
sections.content:
🏃 Emphasizing Ongoing Past Action

Formula: ESTAR (imperfect) + gerund

ESTAR (imperfect):
• estaba
• estabas
• estaba
• estábamos
• estabais
• estaban

Gerund forms:
• -AR → -ando (hablando)
• -ER/-IR → -iendo (comiendo, viviendo)

Examples:
• Estaba comiendo cuando llegaste
  → I was eating when you arrived
• Estaban hablando toda la noche
  → They were talking all night

💡 MORE emphatic than simple imperfect
→ Focuses on the ongoing nature
   at that specific moment

questions.question: What is the preterite 'yo' form of 'hablar'?
questions.hint: Preterite -AR endings: -é. Add accent to distinguish from present.

questions.question: What is the preterite 'yo' form of 'comer'?
questions.hint: Preterite -ER/-IR endings for yo: -í with accent.

questions.question: What is the imperfect 'yo' form of 'hablar'?
questions.hint: Imperfect -AR: add -aba. Very regular pattern.

questions.question: What is the imperfect 'yo' form of 'vivir'?
questions.hint: Imperfect -ER/-IR: add -ía with accent. Very regular.

questions.question: What is the irregular preterite 'yo' form of 'ser/ir'?
questions.hint: Ser and ir share the same preterite forms. This is completely irregular.

questions.question: What is the irregular preterite 'yo' form of 'tener'?
questions.hint: This is a stem-changing irregular. The stem becomes 'tuv-'.

questions.question: What is the irregular imperfect form of 'ser' ('yo')?
questions.hint: Ser is one of only THREE irregular verbs in the imperfect tense.

questions.question: What is the irregular imperfect form of 'ir' ('yo')?
questions.hint: Ir is irregular in the imperfect. Only THREE verbs are irregular in imperfect.

questions.question: How do you form the present perfect in Spanish?
questions.hint: Use the auxiliary verb haber in present tense + the past participle.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'hablar'?
questions.hint: -AR verbs form past participles by changing -ar to -ado.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'comer'?
questions.hint: -ER verbs form past participles by changing -er to -ido.

questions.question: What is the irregular past participle of 'hacer'?
questions.hint: This is a very common irregular past participle. Think 'fact' in English.

questions.question: How do you say 'I have eaten'?
questions.hint: Present perfect: he (haber present) + comido (past participle).

questions.question: Which tense: 'Ayer fui al cine' (Yesterday I went to the cinema)?
questions.hint: 'Ayer' (yesterday) indicates a specific completed action in the past. Use preterite.

questions.question: Which tense: 'Cuando era niño, jugaba mucho' (When I was a child, I played a lot)?
questions.hint: Habitual actions in the past (used to) and descriptions use imperfect.

questions.question: 'Hoy he comido pizza' - Which tense and why?

answers.text: Present perfect - recent past connected to present

questions.hint: 'Hoy' (today) connects the past action to the present time frame. Use present perfect.

questions.question: 'Leía cuando sonó el teléfono' - Which tenses are used?
questions.hint: Background/ongoing action (reading) in imperfect, interrupting action (phone rang) in preterite.

questions.question: How do you form the past perfect (pluscuamperfecto)?
questions.hint: Use haber in the imperfect tense (había, habías...) + past participle.

questions.question: 'Cuando llegué, ya había comido' - What does this mean?

answers.text: When I arrived, he/she had already eaten
When I arrived, he/she was eating
When I arrive, he/she will eat

questions.hint: Past perfect shows an action (eating) that happened BEFORE another past action (arriving).

questions.question: How do you form the past progressive?
questions.hint: Use estar in the imperfect (estaba, estabas...) + gerund (-ando/-iendo).

questions.question: 'Estaba comiendo cuando llegaste' means...

answers.text: I was eating when you arrived
I had eaten when you arrived
I would eat when you arrived

questions.hint: Past progressive emphasizes the ongoing action at that specific moment in the past.

questions.question: Which trigger words suggest PRETERITE?
questions.hint: Preterite uses specific completed time markers: yesterday, last night, last year.

questions.question: Which trigger words suggest IMPERFECT?
questions.hint: Imperfect uses habitual/ongoing markers: always, every day, while.
